question: Aminoglycoside affects ?

options.opa: Outer hair cells in basal area
options.opb: Inner hair cells in basal area
options.opc: Outer hair cells in apical area
options.opd: Inner hair cells in apical area

analysis: Aminoglycosides are a class of antibiotics that can cause ototoxicity, primarily affecting the auditory system. Research indicates that these drugs primarily damage the outer hair cells in the cochlea, and this damage is more pronounced in the basal turn of the cochlea, which is responsible for high-frequency sound detection.
